Linked ADR: docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md

Wire the Rust Voice Gateway WebSocket session into the existing adapter boundaries so a live session can flow from binary frontend PCM through STT evidence, gateway-owned turn state, Pi RPC Brain prompts, TTS synthesis, and binary frontend output audio.

Acceptance criteria:
- On session start, construct the loadout-selected STT and TTS adapters and bind them to the same gateway session.
- Binary frontend PCM is forwarded to STT; emitted STT/VAD frames are processed through the turn manager.
- Committed user turns prompt the Pi RPC Brain, and Brain text deltas/done/tool events are consumed without direct LLM calls.
- Brain deltas are streamed to the frontend as assistant text events and sentence-sized text is sent to TTS.
- TTS audio chunks are sent back to the frontend as binary PCM and comparable trace events are written.
- Interrupts cancel TTS and abort the Pi Brain.
- Add tests that exercise the orchestration without requiring real Pi/STT/TTS services.
- Preserve the legacy TypeScript bridge path.
- Run cargo check/test and relevant bun checks.

note: Wired the Rust Voice Gateway WebSocket loop into the live adapter path: session startup now constructs loadout-selected STT and TTS adapters, binary frontend PCM is forwarded into STT, drained STT/VAD frames flow through the turn manager, committed turns prompt the Pi RPC Brain, Brain text deltas stream to the frontend and sentence-buffer into TTS requests, TTS output PCM is sent as binary WebSocket audio, and interrupts abort Pi plus cancel TTS. Added nonblocking adapter drains, frontend event mappings, TTS reference resolution, local unit coverage, and changelog coverage.
